If the main index (PyPI) can satisfy everything, a non-existent extra index is… actually, pip will try to connect to the extra index and if it fails (DNS error on the `<REDACTED>` host), pip will fail. 2. Demospipes build order (4 images)

Each backend build: uv sync with lots of dependencies (pandas, scikit-learn, etc.) — with BuildKit's cache, each could take several minutes. 25 backends × ~3–8 min = 1.5–3 hours.
